title: Zeus community feature rebuild contract
description: zeus-build.json at the root of a community feature's source repository. The catalog rebuild check restores dependencies online, builds offline, and compares the rebuilt files with the submitted ZIP. tools/verify-source-build.ps1 additionally enforces path containment, rejects links, and requires every ZIP file to be accounted for.

project.description: Feature project, relative to the repository root. Its build output supplies every DLL and the entrypoint .deps.json in the ZIP.

node.description: Optional browser builds, run before the .NET build in listed order.

script.description: package.json script run with npm run.

package.description: Every ZIP file other than DLLs and the entrypoint .deps.json, mapped from its path inside the ZIP to its path in the source tree after the build.

relativePath.description: Forward-slash path relative to the repository root: never absolute, never containing . or .. segments, backslashes, or empty segments.

relativeDirectory.description: Relative directory, or . for the repository root.
